notes: A picture that has not got its data yet is no longer read as a slow one: the rate is only measured while the film is actually showing, so the first seconds of a sharp size on a slow connection can no longer cost it the picture.
The measurement gives up one size per film, not one per window: a 4K picture that cannot keep up lands on FULL HD once and stays there, instead of being walked down the list every few seconds.
The size list stops marking heights that were never on screen long enough to be judged.
